title: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model of enalapril

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Institute for Theoretical Biology, Berlin, Germany
creators.name: Palwankar, Shubhankar

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Faculty of Life Sciences, Department of Biology, Institute of Theoretical Biology, Systems Medicine of the Liver; University of Stuttgart, Institute of Structural Mechanics and Dynamics in Aerospace Engineering; University of Southern Denmark, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine, Department of Public Health; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Lübeck, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
This repository provides the enalapril physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model: the absorption of the prodrug enalapril, its hydrolysis by the hepatic carboxylesterase 1 to the active enalaprilat, the distribution of both and the binding of enalaprilat to tissue ACE, their renal excretion relative to the glomerular filtration, and the inhibition of ACE in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system with its effect on the blood pressure.
